text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Crane game result: "Failure" recorded.
Good work, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, it was quite a rare experience.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 'Cheering' by your side linked with Master's emotions
far more than anticipated—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I found myself holding my breath, clenching my fists, and the like.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I was able to experience firsthand
just how difficult claw crane games really are.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
And excellent work today, Master.
It ended in a disappointing result...
